# Refinement and solution design — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens to requirements clarification, solution options, estimation,
unknowns, spikes, acceptance criteria, or discussion of how work should be
built. Combine it with other matching lenses; do not force the whole segment
into refinement when it also contains planning or strategy.

## What to extract

- State the problem, business context, and constraints.
- List each option with its proposer, arguments, and disposition.
- Separate decisions from exploration; preserve rationale and confirmer.
- Capture work breakdown only as deeply as the board warrants.
- Name unknowns, spikes, owners, risks, mitigations, and explicitly parked work.
- Flag significant technical decisions as decision-record candidates.

## Missing topics worth noting

Note materially absent acceptance criteria, ownership, dependencies, testing,
rollback, or next steps. Apply team-specific meeting guidance before deciding
that an absence is unusual.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not turn options into decisions, exploratory sizing into commitment, or a
brainstormed work breakdown into approved scope.
